text: His favorite drink is red spider blood, he's 36 years, 8 months and 21 days old, studies famous battles of the Fourth and Fifth ages, lives on the North East side of town and his, erm... pet cat is called Fluffy.

Bye!

market where all could trade their wares equally and fairly. The one that became king is the great grandfather of the King Lathas that we know!
